title: Autonomous discrimination of sulfur-transfer channels
difficulty_reasons: The agent must independently formulate and prioritize structural and mechanistic hypotheses for both endpoint-defined channels.
Transition-state discovery, coverage justification, validation, and model-sensitivity analysis are all required before a conclusion.
